examples.source: Time-wise, we should start the meeting now.
examples.target: 在時間方面，我們現在應該開始開會了。

examples.source: Budget-wise, this plan is much better for us.
examples.target: 在預算方面，這個計劃對我們來說好得多。

examples.source: Safety-wise, it is better to wear a helmet.
examples.target: 在安全方面，戴上頭盔會比較好。

examples.source: We invited many guests, including my best friend.
examples.target: 我們邀請了許多客人，包括我最好的朋友。

examples.source: The price includes everything, including lunch and drinks.
examples.target: 這個價格包含所有東西，包括午餐和飲料。

examples.source: I like many sports, including basketball and swimming.
examples.target: 我喜歡很多運動，包括籃球和游泳。

examples.source: It was raining, though we still went to the park.
examples.target: 雖然當時正在下雨，我們還是去了公園。

examples.source: I am tired, though I will finish my homework now.
examples.target: 雖然我很累，但我現在還是會完成功課。

examples.source: She felt nervous, though she did a great job today.
examples.target: 雖然她感到緊張，但她今天表現得很好。

examples.source: It was raining, though we still went to the park.
examples.target: 當時正在下雨，不過我們還是去了公園。

examples.source: The exam was hard, though I finished it on time.
examples.target: 這次考試很難，但我還是準時完成了。

examples.source: I do not like fish, though I eat it sometimes.
examples.target: 我不喜歡吃魚，不過有時候也會吃一點。

examples.source: It was raining, though we still went to the park.
examples.target: 雖然當時正在下雨，但我們還是去了公園。

examples.source: I am not very hungry, though I will eat some.
examples.target: 我不太餓，不過我還是會吃一點。

examples.source: The movie was long, though it was very interesting.
examples.target: 這部電影很長，不過內容非常有趣。

examples.source: I failed the test, which made my parents very sad.
examples.target: 我考試不及格，這令我的父母感到很傷心。

examples.source: He arrived late, which surprised all of his classmates.
examples.target: 他遲到了，這讓所有同學都感到驚訝。

examples.source: She won the competition, which was a great achievement.
examples.target: 她贏得了比賽，這是一項了不起的成就。

examples.source: I bought a new bag, which is very useful for school.
examples.target: 我買了一個新書包，這對上學很有用。

examples.source: He failed the test, which made his parents quite sad.
examples.target: 他考試不及格，這令他的父母很難過。

examples.source: It rained all day, which meant we stayed at home.
examples.target: 整天下雨，這表示我們整天都留在家裡。

examples.source: This drink is sugar-free.
examples.target: 這款飲品不含糖。

examples.source: Our school has a phone-free activity today.
examples.target: 我們學校今天有一個無手機活動。

examples.source: This area is smoke-free.
examples.target: 這個區域是無煙區。

@ mention.meaning: 在社交媒體標註 / @ 提及

examples.source: Please @ mention me when you post the group photo.
examples.target: 當你發佈合照時，請記得 @ 我。

examples.source: I will @ mention my friend if she misses the news.
examples.target: 如果我朋友錯過了這則消息，我會 @ 她。

examples.source: Did you @ mention him in your latest Instagram story?
examples.target: 你有沒有在最新的 Instagram 限時動態中 @ 他？
